sectors.name: Technology
themes: US enterprise AI infrastructure spending is accelerating, driving outsized gains in semiconductor and data-analytics names like MRVL and FICO, independent of Indonesia's muted tech sentiment.
Global IT services providers (ACN, CTSH) are re-rating on cross-border digital transformation contracts, benefiting from US dollar strength and offshore delivery margins.
Software-as-a-service platforms (NOW, CASH) are consolidating pricing power as AI copilots embed into core workflows, creating sticky recurring revenue that outperforms hardware cyclicality.
sectors.ai: Buy selective large-cap tech with US-driven AI monetization and IT services exposure, as MSTR, MRVL, and ACN strength signals durable enterprise demand despite flat aggregate. Rotate into CASH and NOW for software resilience, avoid laggards with weak US revenue mix. Position for Q3 earnings beats on AI infrastructure spend, targeting 8-12% upside over 4 weeks.

US energy sector strength (+1.17%) is lifting global sentiment, benefiting liquid IDX energy names like MEDC and DSSA via correlated capital flows.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: US solar/storage demand is structurally accelerating from data-center electrification and grid resilience, independent of Indonesia's slower policy cycle.
Indonesian renewables remain hostage to PLN's monopoly procurement and unresolved feed-in tariff disputes, capping near-term upside for local climate-tech.
Global supply-chain reshoring under the IRA is creating durable margin expansion for US inverter and module makers, a theme absent in Indonesia's import-dependent sector.
sectors.ai: Buy selective US-listed solar/energy storage names (SEDG, ENPH, RUN) on the AI-driven power demand and IRA manufacturing pull-through; avoid Indonesian renewables laggards until tariff clarity and PLN offtake reforms materialize. Trim PLUG exposure on ongoing liquidity risk.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Premiumization and health-conscious product shifts are structurally lifting margins for F&B players like EL and BEEF, outpacing broad-market growth.
Digital distribution and direct-to-consumer channels are enabling smaller caps (AGAR, BACH, NAYZ) to scale faster, reducing reliance on traditional retail.
US consumer strength (+1.75%) is spilling into export-oriented Indonesian FMCG, creating a durable demand tailwind for commodity-linked names like IATA and DEWI.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap consumer names with strong earnings momentum (EL, BEEF, IATA) as US demand signals and domestic resilience drive re-rating; avoid laggards lacking volume growth. Position for Q3 earnings beats and festive-season consumption uplift, targeting 10-15% upside in leaders over 3 months.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's port and terminal operators benefit structurally from rising coal and nickel export volumes, underpinning PPGL and GTSI's relative resilience despite sector-wide softness.
Domestic e-commerce and cold-chain demand continues to outpace GDP growth, supporting SDMU and PSAT's last-mile and warehousing expansion plans into 2025.
Fuel logistics and energy distribution remain defensive cash-flow anchors, with ELPI and MITI leveraging stable Pertamina contracts to fund fleet modernization and route optimization.
sectors.ai: Buy logistics selectively on pullbacks: BULL and RMKE lead on volume-driven momentum, but aggregate sector weakness signals rotation, not reversal. Favor names with port/terminal exposure (PPGL, GTSI) over pure trucking; watch IDX volatility and US rate spillover. Accumulate on dips toward support, trim rallies above +5% for quick gains.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Ethereum's Dencun upgrade and L2 fee compression structurally re-rate ETH and ARB as institutional custody and staking demand rises, making this the core long for the cycle.
DeFi governance tokens like UNI and SKY benefit from fee-switch proposals and real yield accrual, a durable catalyst that decouples them from pure BTC beta.
Indonesian crypto adoption is accelerating via local exchanges and P2P OTC desks, creating a sticky retail bid that amplifies altcoin volatility and rewards early positioning in liquid majors.
sectors.ai: Buy the crypto complex into strength: BTC dominance is fading as ETH, UNI, and ARB lead, signaling rotation into DeFi and L2s—position for a multi-week alt rally. Add exposure via ETH and ARB on pullbacks, and hold BTW/PUMP momentum names with tight stops. Indonesia's retail flow will amplify upside, so overweight now, trim only on a BTC rejection above $70k.
